performance.verdict: Campaigns dead 4 days straight; 9 overdue SOW milestones block all channel proof.

findings.text: Meta went dark Sep 24–27 (4 consecutive zero-spend, zero-lead days); prior 7d efficiency gains ($5.23 CPL) are now paused, not sustained.

9 SOW milestones overdue by 28–89 days: pre-launch stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta CAPI, landing pages, reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA, and nurture sequences — all undelivered.
3-day signal (Sep 25–27): spend $0/$0/$0, leads 0/0/0 vs prior 3-day window (Sep 22–24): spend $57.93/$39.13/$0.53, leads 14/7/0 — confirmed delivery collapse, not a single bad day.
GA4 sessions collapsed from ~150/day baseline to 14–35/day Sep 25–27 (−77%), correlating exactly with Meta dark period — organic floor is insufficient without paid traffic.
GBP actions dropped 47.06% week-on-week; last 4 days show 0 actions each — GBP cannot compensate for paid channel absence at current organic volume (69 actions over 28 days).

suggestions.text: Diagnose and restore Meta delivery today; campaign MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP was spending $39–68/day before cutoff.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has been completely dark since Sep 24 — $0 spend and 0 leads for 4 consecutive days, ending a run where the top campaign (MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP) was generating leads at $5.23 CPL. Immediately check account status, billing, ad-set approval, and audience delivery errors in Meta Ads Manager. Success is confirmed when daily spend returns to the $39–68/day range seen Sep 20–22 and leads resume within 48 hours — by Sep 30.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 9 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer and Sohib; Phase 1 has no verified tracking stack 89 days in.
suggestions.monday_update: Nine SOW deliverables are overdue by 28 to 89 days, including the pre-launch stack test, Meta CAPI, Como→GHL migration, landing pages, and Search campaigns — none confirmed complete. Without these, attribution is unverified and the booked-appointment benchmark (the Phase 1 success metric) cannot be tracked. Nacer must provide a written status and revised completion date for each item by Oct 2. Phase 1 end date (Sep 30) should be formally reassessed with Mateus and his father given the current delivery gap.

suggestions.text: Watch GA4 sessions: if below 50/day for 3 more days after Meta restores, investigate direct traffic or tracking break.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 sessions dropped from a ~150/day baseline to 14–35/day on Sep 25–27, coinciding with Meta going dark. If Meta delivery restores but sessions remain below 50/day by Oct 1, this indicates either a tracking break (landing pages not live per SOW) or a direct-traffic problem independent of paid. Re-check Oct 1 after Meta is confirmed live.
